hook.en: A family earns salary and pays for food, rent and electricity every month. The government also has regular income, like taxes, and regular bills, like salaries and interest. These form the revenue account. What goes in it?
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ಕುಟುಂಬ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ಸಂಬಳ ಗಳಿಸಿ ಆಹಾರ, ಬಾಡಿಗೆ, ವಿದ್ಯುತ್‌ಗೆ ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸರ್ಕಾರಕ್ಕೂ ತೆರಿಗೆಯಂತಹ ನಿಯಮಿತ ಆದಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಬಳ, ಬಡ್ಡಿಯಂತಹ ನಿಯಮಿತ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳಿವೆ. ಇವು ಆದಾಯ ಖಾತೆ. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಏನೇನು ಬರುತ್ತದೆ?

objectives.en: Define revenue receipts and classify them

narration.en: A family earns salary and pays for food, rent and electricity every month. The government also has regular income, like taxes, and regular bills, like salaries and interest. These form the revenue account. What goes in it?
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಕುಟುಂಬ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ಸಂಬಳ ಗಳಿಸಿ ಆಹಾರ, ಬಾಡಿಗೆ, ವಿದ್ಯುತ್‌ಗೆ ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸರ್ಕಾರಕ್ಕೂ ತೆರಿಗೆಯಂತಹ ನಿಯಮಿತ ಆದಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಬಳ, ಬಡ್ಡಿಯಂತಹ ನಿಯಮಿತ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳಿವೆ. ಇವು ಆದಾಯ ಖಾತೆ. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಏನೇನು ಬರುತ್ತದೆ?

body.en: Revenue receipts are receipts that neither create a liability nor reduce the assets of the government. They are of two kinds. Tax revenue: direct taxes, whose burden cannot be shifted (personal income tax, corporation tax), and indirect taxes, whose burden can be shifted (GST, customs duties, excise duties). Non-tax revenue: interest received on loans given, dividends and profits from public enterprises, fees, fines, and grants received.

points.en: No liability created, no asset reduced
Direct taxes: income tax, corporation tax
Non-tax: interest, dividends, fees, fines, grants

narration.en: Revenue receipts are receipts that neither create a liability nor reduce the assets of the government. They are of two kinds. Tax revenue: direct taxes, whose burden cannot be shifted (personal income tax, corporation tax), and indirect taxes, whose burden can be shifted (GST, customs duties, excise duties). Non-tax revenue: interest received on loans given, dividends and profits from public enterprises, fees, fines, and grants received.
narration.kn: ಆದಾಯ ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿಗಳು ಸರ್ಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಆಸ್ತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ತೆರಿಗೆ ಆದಾಯ: ನೇರ ತೆರಿಗೆ (ಆದಾಯ ತೆರಿಗೆ, ಕಾರ್ಪೊರೇಟ್ ತೆರಿಗೆ) ಮತ್ತು ಪರೋಕ್ಷ ತೆರಿಗೆ (GST, ಸುಂಕಗಳು). ತೆರಿಗೆಯೇತರ ಆದಾಯ: ಬಡ್ಡಿ, ಲಾಭಾಂಶ, ಶುಲ್ಕ, ದಂಡ, ಅನುದಾನಗಳು.

title.en: On the board: The revenue account

narration.en: The revenue account holds the government’s regular receipts and spending.

say.en: Test for a revenue receipt: no new liability, no fall in assets.

text.en: Test: no liability, no asset sold

say.en: Revenue receipts split into tax revenue and non-tax revenue.
Direct taxes cannot be shifted; indirect taxes can. Non-tax revenue is interest, dividends, fees and fines.
Revenue expenditure creates no asset and cuts no liability.

text.en: Test: no asset, no debt repaid

say.en: Add up an example: tax 1,800 and non-tax 300 give revenue receipts of 2,100 crore.

body.en: Revenue expenditure is expenditure that neither creates physical or financial assets nor reduces the liabilities of the government. It covers the normal running of government departments and services: salaries and pensions, interest payments on debt, subsidies, and grants to state governments and other bodies. Grants to states count as revenue expenditure of the Centre even if the states use some of them to create assets.

points.en: No asset created, no liability reduced
Grants to states: revenue expenditure of the Centre

narration.en: Revenue expenditure is expenditure that neither creates physical or financial assets nor reduces the liabilities of the government. It covers the normal running of government departments and services: salaries and pensions, interest payments on debt, subsidies, and grants to state governments and other bodies. Grants to states count as revenue expenditure of the Centre even if the states use some of them to create assets.
narration.kn: ಆದಾಯ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಎಂದರೆ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸದ, ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡದ ವೆಚ್ಚ: ಸಂಬಳ, ಪಿಂಚಣಿ, ಸಾಲದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಬಡ್ಡಿ, ಸಹಾಯಧನ, ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಅನುದಾನ. ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳಿಗೆ ನೀಡುವ ಅನುದಾನ ಕೇಂದ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಆದಾಯ ವೆಚ್ಚವೇ.

caption.en: Revenue receipts = direct taxes + indirect taxes + non-tax revenue (illustrative, ₹ thousand crore).

narration.en: Change the three parts of revenue receipts and watch the total and the share of taxes.

label.en: Share of direct taxes in tax revenue

tryThis.en: Set direct 900, indirect 900, non-tax 300. Are revenue receipts 2,100?
Raise indirect taxes. Who finally bears the extra burden?

problem.en: Classify each item and find revenue receipts (₹ crore): income tax 1,000; GST 800; dividends from public sector firms 200; fees and fines 100; salaries paid 900; interest paid 400.

steps.en: Non-tax revenue: dividends 200 + fees and fines 100 = 300.
Salaries 900 and interest 400 are revenue expenditure (total 1,300), not receipts.

answer.en: Revenue receipts = ₹2,100 crore; salaries and interest are revenue expenditure (₹1,300 crore).

homework.en: Make a two-column list of five revenue receipts and five revenue expenditures of the Union government.

narration.en: Recap. Revenue receipts create no liability and reduce no asset. Tax revenue is direct (income tax) or indirect (GST); non-tax revenue includes interest, dividends, fees. Revenue expenditure creates no asset and reduces no liability. Salaries, interest, subsidies and grants to states are revenue expenditure.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಆದಾಯ ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿಗಳು ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಆಸ್ತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ತೆರಿಗೆ ಆದಾಯ ನೇರ ಅಥವಾ ಪರೋಕ್ಷ; ತೆರಿಗೆಯೇತರ ಆದಾಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಡ್ಡಿ, ಲಾಭಾಂಶ, ಶುಲ್ಕ. ಆದಾಯ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಸಂಬಳ, ಬಡ್ಡಿ, ಸಹಾಯಧನ, ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಅನುದಾನ ಆದಾಯ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳು.
